limited_txt_mappings.limit: Only main Chrome PID txt (executable/library) mappings were checked. No URL/arguments or general open user files were queried. Absence here does not prove no helper or other process holds a clone.

limits: App Info.plist values do not prove equivalence to current upstream source.
Directory entry_bytes is filesystem directory metadata, not recursive app bytes.
du sampled allocated-block counts will not establish exclusive physical storage or reclaimable bytes.

line_evidence.fact: CloneApp uses copy-on-write clonefile to duplicate the app.
The clone main executable is replaced with a hard link to the source main executable.
The manager arranges helper-process cleanup after browser exit.
The cloned app may use a .bundle suffix to avoid Launch Services registration issues.
A TODO proposes cleaning inactive clones if the count gets too high.

limits: Current lkgr source is not asserted to be the exact source of installed Chrome 155.0.8059.85.
Older source expectation of about 1-5 clones was supplied by controller but not independently verified in this read; it is not used as a measured threshold.
No conclusion about which application or automation created each clone is drawn from folder names alone.

conclusions.structure: All three representative directories contain Google Chrome.app.bundle/Contents with app metadata/frameworks/executable structure.
conclusions.interpretation: The measured storage path contains hundreds of same-version Chrome app-bundle clone directories accumulated over approximately 58 hours. Its naming/structure is consistent with the Chromium code-sign clone mechanism. This is strong evidence of clone accumulation, not a measurement of exclusive physical storage or a proof that all 772.07 GB of System Data belongs to these clones.
conclusions.current_process_limit: No executable path in the ps snapshot pointed into the clone root. One installed Chrome main process was observed. Limited main-PID executable/library mappings are recorded separately; no claim all clones are unused.
actions_not_performed: No user browsing data or command-line arguments inspected.
conclusions.inode_evidence: See metadata_inode_comparison: hard-linked files can be directly identified by same device/inode; distinct inode APFS extent sharing cannot be determined by this comparison.
conclusions.physical_allocation_limit: Exclusive physical allocation of the clone directories was not measured in this limited diagnostic. du, same/different inode and st_blocks do not establish exclusive APFS extents. No root permissions, full open-file traversal or extent analysis was attempted; this is not a claim that all possible measurement tools are unavailable. Clone accumulation is confirmed, while attribution of the whole System Data 772.07 GB remains unconfirmed.

metadata_inode_comparison.method: lstat of main executable, Info.plist, and two explicit framework-version binaries in each of three sample clones plus installed app (16 stat records). No binary content or recursive file enumeration.

comparisons.conclusion: Different inodes do not establish either shared or independent APFS extents. No exclusive-byte conclusion.
